description: This file defines a configuration structure and parsing utilities for 'Talk' provider configurations, including selection, resolution, and timeout handling, in a Swift project related to speech or communication services.

methods.name: bridgeFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Converts a raw dictionary with String keys and Any values into a dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values.

methods.name: selectProviderConfig
methods.description: Selects a provider configuration from a dictionary, applying fallback logic based on provided defaults and normalization flags.

methods.name: resolvedPositiveInt
methods.description: Resolves an AnyCodable value to a positive integer, using fallback if necessary.

methods.name: resolvedSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Extracts and resolves the silence timeout in milliseconds from a configuration dictionary, with a fallback value.

methods.name: normalizedTalkProviderID
methods.description: Normalizes a provider ID string by trimming whitespace, converting to lowercase, and returning nil if empty.

methods.name: resolvedProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves and extracts provider configuration details from a 'talk' dictionary, returning a selected provider config if available.
